official: 府中市廃棄物の処理及び再生利用に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会市長提出議案

name: 審議会を置き廃棄物関連の規定を改める
summary: 現在の条例は、市長が府中市廃棄物減量等推進審議会を設置できると定めています。この議案では審議会を置く規定に改め、再生資源の定義や廃棄物に関する法律の参照先を更新します。
changes: 事業者が利用に努める再生資源の参照先を法律第2条第1項から第2条第4項に変える
審議会を設置できる規定を、審議会を置く規定に変える
審議会の設置根拠を法律第5条の2から第5条の7に変える
多量の一般廃棄物について市長が指示できる根拠を法律第6条の2第5項から第7項に変える
why: 廃棄物の処理及び清掃に関する法律の一部改正に伴う改正のためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Establishes a council and revises waste-related provisions
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Fuchu City Ordinance on the Disposal and Recycling of Waste
en.summary: The current ordinance says the mayor may establish the Fuchu City Council for the Promotion of Waste Reduction, etc. This bill changes the provision to require that the council be established, and updates the definition of recyclable resources and references to laws concerning waste.
changes: Changes the reference for recyclable resources that businesses are encouraged to use from Article 2, paragraph 1 to Article 2, paragraph 4 of the Act
Changes the provision from allowing the mayor to establish the council to requiring that the council be established
Changes the legal basis for establishing the council from Article 5-2 to Article 5-7 of the Act
Changes the legal basis for the mayor to issue instructions concerning large quantities of general waste from Article 6-2, paragraph 5 to paragraph 7 of the Act
en.why: The city says the ordinance is being amended in response to a partial amendment to the Waste Management and Public Cleansing Act.
